D/ [FLIVL CONST]ANS AVG ; R/ GLOR[IA EXERCIT]VS

Copper alloy nummus of the House of Constantine - probably Constans reverse type GLORIA EXERCITVS two soldiers one standard (AD 337-341) - struck at the mint of Trier (Treveri). Reece Period: 17. Reference: LRBC - 110. Obverse description: Curiassed laureate bust facing right. Obverse inscription: [FLIVL CONST]ANS AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers - one standard.
